decisions.reason: The connector placement and orientation decision does not change the established enclosure orientation, dimensions, aspect ratio, or mounting-hole constraints.
Physical placement and orientation of the battery JST do not change the NTC terminal, controller, or thermal-protection behavior.
The connector layout decision does not alter the battery protection controller or its overcharge and overdischarge thresholds.
Battery-JST placement and orientation do not affect the SK6812 charge-status display method or GPIO assignment.
The board JST's mechanical orientation does not change the I2C cable-length, bus-speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location requirements.
The source concerns battery and interboard JST connectors, not the USB connector, USB data lines, or USB connector sourceability.
The power-board connector arrangement does not change the selected addressable-LED family or its data GPIO.
The battery and interboard JST placement decision does not alter the boost converter, enable control, default state, or powered loads.
